title: How AI Really Works: Course Final

cards.prompt: A smart speaker understands adults well, but often gets children's voices wrong. What's the most likely cause?

options.text: Few children's voices in the examples it learned from
Its microphone is too weak to pick up quieter voices
It wasn't given enough training data of any kind
Someone set it up to ignore children on purpose

cards.explanation: This is **bias**: it usually comes from **gaps in the training data**. If few children's voices were in its examples, it works worse for children. A huge pile of adult voices wouldn't fix that, and nobody has to mean it. The fix: add children's voices and test with them.

cards.prompt: This model guesses whether a photo was taken by day or by night, from its brightness and how much sky it shows. It calls a sunny day **indoors** night. Choose the examples to train on, so it gets **every** test photo right.

examples.text: Blue sky at the beach: day
examples.label: day

examples.text: Dark evening, deep blue sky: night
examples.label: night

cards.explanation: The model had only seen day photos with lots of sky, so a bright room with no sky sat nearest the night photos. Adding **"Bright classroom, no sky"** fills that gap. More sunny outdoor photos don't help.

cards.prompt: A model is tested on **20** new photos it never saw in training, and gets **18** right. What is its accuracy?
cards.explanation: 18 right out of 20 is the same share as 9 out of 10: **90%**. Accuracy is the share of **test** examples it gets right.

cards.prompt: Which word is this model **most likely** to pick next?
cards.explanation: "Good night, sleep **tight**" is a common saying, so "tight" has the biggest chance, even though "well" makes just as much sense.

cards.prompt: A chatbot gives you a quote from a famous scientist, word for word, sounding completely sure. What should you do?

options.text: Trust it if the chatbot's temperature was set low
Ask the chatbot which book the quote comes from
Find the quote in a trusted source: it might be invented
Use it: it sounded completely sure of the words

cards.explanation: Quotes are classic **hallucinations**: likely-sounding words, not checked ones. Asking the chatbot for the book can just produce another invented answer, and low temperature makes it predictable, not true. Check a trusted source.

cards.prompt: Is each use of AI **honest**, or **not honest**?

items.label: Noting "AI helped draft this" at work
Asking if AI is allowed in a contest
An AI picture entered as your photo
Giving a friend an AI poem as yours

cards.explanation: Saying how AI helped and asking about the rules first are **honest**. Entering an AI picture as your own photo, or passing off an AI poem as yours, claims work that isn't yours.

cards.prompt: A video of a famous athlete announcing a surprise retirement is going viral. No AI label, lips match perfectly. What's the **best** check?

options.text: Check whether it has an AI watermark anywhere
Watch it frame by frame, looking for glitches
See if their official account or trusted news says so
See how many people have already shared it

cards.explanation: A missing watermark proves nothing, good deepfakes have no glitches to find, and shares aren't evidence. Check the **real person's official account** or trusted news.

cards.prompt: A friend tells you a secret, and you want advice about it. You're thinking of asking an AI chatbot.

steps.text: What's the best thing to do?

choices.text: Ask the chatbot for advice, but leave out your friend's name
choices.consequence: Better, but it's still your friend's secret to keep, and the details can give away who it is. The chat may be stored, too.

choices.text: Talk it through with a trusted adult, without naming your friend
choices.consequence: A person you trust can really help, and your friend's secret stays safe.

choices.text: Send the chatbot a screenshot of your friend's message
choices.consequence: That shares your friend's private message, and maybe their name and number too.

cards.explanation: A friend's secret isn't yours to type into an app, even without their name. A **trusted adult** can help without it leaving your hands.
